name: android_rotate_gesture
description: Two-finger rotation by angleDegrees (positive = clockwise) around a center point. centerX/centerY and radius are screen fractions when within 0.0-1.0, otherwise pixels.

angleDegrees.description: Angle of rotation in degrees (> 0 clockwise, < 0 counter-clockwise).

radius.description: Radius of two-finger touch circle in pixels or normalized ratio (default 200).

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
